# nature-skills source attribution

Source: Yuan1z0825/nature-skills, commit `79c9f986501ff462f4b9d1294c8223bfee1a5149`.
Repository: https://github.com/Yuan1z0825/nature-skills

The selected files under `skills/` are unmodified upstream reference material, retained for provenance and offline comparison. Their byte hashes are in `manifest.json`. The upstream root Apache-2.0 license is retained in `LICENSE`; no root NOTICE or additional license notices in the selected reviewer/statistics directories were found in this snapshot.

The project adaptations are in `server/nature-rules.js`, authored 2026-09-25. They replace Nature editorial thresholds with bounded ecological review methods, remove the three-reviewer workflow, retain missing-evidence safeguards, and use the application's structured results and evidence validation. These are trial rules, not official journal standards.

The source files link to and summarize third-party publications. No Nature website content, journal article, upstream editorial-criteria transcription, unrelated scripts, or bundled third-party assets are redistributed here. Such linked sources retain their own rights; the repository license is not a blanket license for them. The copied skill files are reference data and are not installed or executed as agent instructions.
